title: Pizza Hut Was the King. How Domino's Took the Crown
description:
In 2015 Pizza Hut sold more pizza in America than anyone. Ten years later its owner sold the whole chain, and Domino's held nearly twice its share.
This is the whole pizza war, told from the companies' SEC filings and reporting: the red-roof restaurants built for sitting down, the delivery chain built for the phone, the ad where Domino's admitted its pizza was bad, the app, the tracker, the closures, and the one country where Pizza Hut still wins.
